_comment: LBC/USDT accumulation (MEXC spot) — ⚠ REAL MONEY, the only live bot in the fleet; see _live_note. Same v2.0 accumulation engine as btc_accumulation_mexc, adapted for the sub-cent alt LBCUSDT. Price/OBI come from a dedicated MEXC-spot scalping stream (lbc_scalping_mexc, sourced from the shared cex_feed mexc:LBCUSDT) that the bot self-registers with the indicators service over TCP 5561 (proven to work cross-account, same host). The BTC-specific macro gates (liquidations, L/S ratio, 4h-RSI, macro-OBI, Fear&Greed) are DISABLED — they are Bitcoin-market signals that do not apply to LBC; accumulation is driven by LBC's own OBI + VWAP only.
_band_note: The requested 0.001–0.0025 range is not a hard bound (the accumulation engine has no lower/upper band like the grid). It emerges from behaviour: dip-buying pulls entries down toward ~0.001 and the profit bands (+5..+50% from a ~0.0021 avg entry, i.e. up to ~0.00253) take profit as price rises toward 0.0025.
_live_note: REAL MONEY, ARMED. Buy-only accumulation (Option B): live_execution routes buys to real MEXC maker resting bids, credited only on actual fill. Clips are tiny ($10 initial / $5 dip-adds; both validated via order/test — minNotional is 1 USDT) vs the thin book. Exposure is capped at ONE resting clip at a time (the pending_buy guard), budget $100 tracked internally. Requires EnvironmentFile=~/.config/tradinebotte/mexc7.env + TRADINEBOTTE_IPV4_ONLY=1 on the unit; without the key the connector fail-safes to paper. Buy-only: profit-band sells + rebuys are skipped when live_execution=true — we never sell into the ~$27/10% bid book. Set shadow=true to disarm back to logging-only.
